messages:
Jordan (Sales): FYI handing Averis Health to CS — signed 12mo dedicated, go-live planned 2025-05-10. High-level: SSO (SAML) pending, on-prem data access request, and renewal may be at risk if SLA/latency targets slip. Quick recap + owners below.
Priya (CSM): Thanks @Jordan — can you paste the account bundle + SAML metadata and contact list? I'll schedule kickoff.
Jordan (Sales): Deck + configs: https://redwood.app/prop/averis-activation. SAML metadata is on Zendesk ticket A-4321. P0 perf target: 95th pct <200ms. They want private deployment by Q3; pricing committed conditional on that. Contacts: Melissa (melissa@averishealth.com), Raj Patel (CTO).
Devin (Support): Copied. Clarify infra plan: dedicated reserved capacity or hosted for initial launch?
Jordan (Sales): Dedicated reserved: 4xA100 initially, can spike to 6x for onboarding testing.
Priya (CSM): Tentative action list — 1) SSO test (owner: Priya) 2) Provision sandbox + VPC peering (owner: Devin) 3) Engineering enablement session (owner: Priya) 4) Baseline perf test (owner: Nora) 5) SLA + renewal language review (owner: Jordan). I'll add dates once infra ticket exists.
Nora (Eng): I'll own perf tests. Please grant read-only access to model logs and KV cache traces for the perf team. Command I'll run locally: `./run_perf.sh --seq 1024 --batch 8 --profile kv_cache`
Devin (Support): Provisioning note: sandbox requires VPC peering + KMS key material. I'll open infra ticket INF-7882 and assign. ETA ~3 business days.
Priya (CSM): Risk note: CFO wants unit cost < $0.0006/token. We'll evaluate Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization). Action: Priya + Nora to run int8 quant eval and report latency/quality tradeoffs.
Jordan (Sales): Also capture a product feedback item — customer saw hallucination with medical prompts in our eval run. Jordan -> attaching a short sample prompt set in the ticket. Need Research/QA to ingest.
Priya (CSM): Attached sample prompts and a short transcript excerpt in Zendesk A-4321. Scheduling kickoff Tue 10am PT; will invite Melissa, Raj, and their infra lead. Can folks confirm owners and blockers?
Devin (Support): Confirm owners. Current blocker: SAML metadata mismatch; awaiting fix from their IdP (notes on A-4321).
Nora (Eng): Confirm. If sandbox provisioning slips, can Ops allow a temporary perf uplift on dedicated so I can run baseline earlier?
Devin (Support): I can request temporary uplift; will note in INF-7882.
oncall-bot: INF-7882 created by Devin. ETA: 3d. Link: https://redwood.app/tickets/INF-7882
Jordan (Sales): Thanks — I'll loop in Renewals once we have SLA draft and perf baseline. Priya, please keep me updated on the SSO and onboarding cadence.
Priya (CSM): Will do. I'll post weekly status updates in this thread and add owners into Asana checklist (SSO test, sandbox, perf, enablement). Closing for now until SAML is resolved — re-open with updates.
